title: REBORN MECH-BEASTS: THE ODDGUARD II
synopsis: Alan returns from space not as a hero but as a blood-powered, regenerating creature that turns humanity's own mechs against their operators. Leo and the Oddguard — a team of cybernetic animals — discover that only Nix, a small cat bonded to a mysterious energy core, can stop it. Defeating the creature only reveals a larger threat: the alien agent Vark, hunting two hidden energy cores, one of which lives inside Nix.

audienceReactions.quote: I'm glad the story gave the creature something worth fighting for.
audienceReactions.author: @GTMoviehd
